name: Featured icon
summary: Decorative icon in a tinted circle. Gives Alerts, Modals and Empty states a visual anchor.
use: At the top of a Modal or Empty state.
In Alerts and Toasts as a status icon.
avoid: As a button or as a separate informative icon.
figmaProps: Gray, Brand, Error, Warning, Success, Info
a11y: Decorative: aria-hidden. The meaning is in the text next to it.
do: Match the color to the status of the content.
dont: A featured icon with no text next to it.
